---

I wrote `specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md` as above and will commit it on `main`. It is one research track ranked O1–O4. Only the core stage is committed: **Stage 1, O1 on real data**. Its findings file records what the fit shows and what the real run cost. O2, O3 and O4 wait in the Ranked list until Stage 1 has run, because the result may change their order.

Two things to settle before Stage 1. The file lists both under Open questions:

1. **O4 should probably be its own track. I should have caught this in my last message.** The closure-history map does not need the gauge model, and it serves boat operators rather than the board. In Track A it waits until O1's core stage is done, and then waits again behind O2 and O3. As a separate known-progression track it could be built at any time for about a day of work. Stage 1 is the same either way. If you agree, I'll split it out before handing anything off.
2. **Traceability** means each estimate names the gauge readings it came from, which the board will ask for. I placed it as Ranked-list item 5. Stage 1 leaves it out on purpose, so the first run stays small. You didn't rank it, so tell me if it should move up. One option is to make it the next item promoted after Stage 1, ahead of O2.

Please approve the partition or change it. On approval:

Next: /clear (or a fresh session), then brainstorming on Stage 1 of `specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md`. The stage spec's Rollout note carries:
`Roadmap: specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md, Stage 1`
